name: FV_BC_CONTROL_TYPES
description: This table contains the  budgetary control type definition that will be used to create  federal control budgets in fusion budgetary control module automatically.

columns.name: CONTROL_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier for the budgetary control type

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier associated to the budgetary control type

columns.name: BUDGET_LEVEL_ID
columns.description: Budget Level identifier of the control type

columns.name: CONTROL_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: Name associated with the budgetary control type

columns.name: CONTROL_TYPE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description associated with budgetary control type description

columns.name: CONTROL_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Budgetary control level  associated with the federal control type

columns.name: PARENT_CONTROL_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Parent budgetary control type associated  with the control type

columns.name: BUDGET_MANAGER_ID
columns.description: Budget manager assigned  to the control type

columns.name: ANTICIPATED_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the control type associated with anticipated budgetary control type

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PERCENT
columns.description: Control budget approval tolerance percent

columns.name: TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Control budget approval tolerance amount.

columns.name: ALLOW_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to allow override the control budget approval

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status  of the control budget creation

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Currency rate type associated with the control budget.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_BUDGET_CTRL_ID
columns.description: Federal distribution control budget identifier  created for this control type

columns.name: CONSUMPTION_BUDGET_CTRL_ID
columns.description: Federal consumption control budget identifier  created for this control type

columns.name: BUDGET_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Chart of accounts identifier of general ledger flexfield associated with this control type

columns.name: GL_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Chart of accounts identifier of general ledger flexfield associated with this control type

columns.name: BUDGET_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Budget category code. Possible values are Budget and Anticipated recovery.

columns.name: DEFAULT_TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Transaction type associated with the budget control.

columns.name: CLOSING_TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Transaction type associated with closing the budget control.

columns.name: BUDGET_ACCOUNT
columns.description: Budget account for the budget control.

columns.name: BUDGET_DISTRIBUTION_ACCOUNT
columns.description: Budget distribution account for the budget control.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTE_BUDGET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the budget is distributed.

columns.name: CONSUME_BUDGET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the budget is consumed.

columns.name: PROJECT_ID
columns.description: Project associated with the budget.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the budget control transactions associated with primary ledger.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
